Usage: backlog milestone|milestones [options] [command]

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                list milestones with completion status
  add [options] <name>          add a milestone file
  rename [options] <from> <to>  rename a milestone file and update local tasks
                                by default
  remove [options] <name>       remove a milestone file and clear, keep, or
                                reassign matching tasks
  archive <name>                archive a milestone by id or title
  help [command]                display help for command

Usage: backlog milestone rename [options] <from> <to>

rename a milestone file and update local tasks by default

Options:
  --no-update-tasks  do not update local tasks that reference the milestone
  --due-date <date>  set due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --clear-due-date   clear milestone due date
  -h, --help         display help for command


Input schema:
Required fields:
  - from: Milestone ID or title - Existing active milestone to rename
  - to: String - New milestone title; checked for alias conflicts
Optional fields:
  - update-tasks: Boolean - Update local task milestone references; default true, disable with --no-update-tasks
  - due-date: date - Set the milestone due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - clear-due-date: Boolean - Clear the milestone due date
Reads:
  - Active and archived milestone files, plus local tasks when task updates are enabled
Writes:
  - Renames the milestone file and, by default, updates matching local task milestone values
Output:
  - Rename summary, task update count, and file move path when changed
Examples:
  backlog milestone rename "Release 1.0" "Release 2.0"
  backlog milestone rename m-1 "Release 2.0" --no-update-tasks

Usage: backlog milestone add [options] <name>

add a milestone file

Options:
  -d, --description <text>  milestone description
  --due-date <date>         set due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  -h, --help                display help for command


Input schema:
Required fields:
  - name: String - Milestone name/title, trimmed before storage
Optional fields:
  - description: Markdown - Optional milestone description
  - due-date: date - Optional milestone due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Markdown fields:
  - Multi-line values need real newlines; a literal \n is stored as text
  - Example (bash/zsh): --description $'First line\nSecond line'
Reads:
  - Active milestone files for duplicate and alias validation
Writes:
  - Creates a milestone markdown file in the active milestones directory
Output:
  - Created milestone title and ID
Examples:
  backlog milestone add "Release 1.0"
  backlog milestone add "Beta" --description "Beta scope"

Input schema:
Required fields:
  - taskIds: Task IDs - Tasks to update; prompted when omitted in interactive mode. Several IDs apply the same shared-field change to every task
Optional fields:
  - title: String - Replacement task title
  - description: Markdown - Replacement description
  - status: one of configured statuses: To Do, In Progress, Blocked, Done - Project task status; case-insensitive
  - type: one of configured task types: bug, feature, enhancement, task, chore, docs, spike - Replacement task type; case-insensitive
  - project: no projects configured; add a 'projects:' list to the project config file - Replacement task project; case-insensitive; pass an empty value to clear
  - due-date: date - Set the task due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - clear-due-date: Boolean - Clear the task due date
  - assignee: Comma-separated strings - Replace all assignees; repeat -a or use @name1,@name2; -a "" clears them
  - label: Comma-separated strings - Replace all labels; repeat --label or use label1,label2
  - add-label: Comma-separated strings - Add labels; repeat --add-label or use label1,label2
  - remove-label: Comma-separated strings - Remove labels; repeat --remove-label or use label1,label2
  - clear-labels: Boolean - Remove all labels; cannot combine with other label flags
  - clear-deps: Boolean - Remove all task dependencies; cannot combine with dependency flags
  - add-ref: Comma-separated strings - Add references; repeat --add-ref or use ref1,ref2
  - remove-ref: Comma-separated strings - Remove references; repeat --remove-ref or use ref1,ref2
  - clear-refs: Boolean - Remove all references; cannot combine with --ref, --add-ref, or --remove-ref
  - clear-docs: Boolean - Remove all documentation; cannot combine with --doc
  - plan: Markdown - Replacement implementation plan
  - append-plan: Markdown - Append after --plan replacement; repeatable
  - notes: Markdown - Replacement implementation notes
  - append-notes: Markdown - Append to implementation notes; repeatable
  - comment: Markdown - Append a discussion comment
  - final-summary: Markdown - Completion summary
  - append-final-summary: Markdown - Append to final summary; repeatable
  - check-ac: Integer - 1-based acceptance criterion index
Markdown fields:
  - Multi-line values need real newlines; a literal \n is stored as text
  - Example (bash/zsh): --description $'First line\nSecond line'
Writes:
  - Updates task metadata and structured task sections through Backlog.md
Output:
  - Updated task details; use --plain for text output
Examples:
  backlog task edit TASK-1 --status "<active status>" -a @sara
  backlog task edit TASK-1 --type "bug"
  backlog task edit TASK-1 --check-ac 1
  backlog task edit TASK-1 TASK-2 --status "<active status>"
